text: Official CLI can load and run a model directly by specifying its Hugging Face identifier
Official CLI can start a local model server directly from a Hugging Face model identifier
Includes a built-in web UI that connects to the local server for chatting with models
quote: Built-in web UI against `llama serve` running Qwen 3.6

text: CLI supports vision-language model chat sessions with image input
Implemented as a plain C/C++ codebase with no external dependencies
quote: Plain C/C++ implementation without any dependencies

text: Optimized for Apple Silicon via ARM NEON, Accelerate, and Metal frameworks
quote: Apple silicon is a first-class citizen - optimized via ARM NEON, Accelerate and Metal frameworks

text: Supports x86 SIMD instruction sets including AVX, AVX2, AVX512, and AMX for faster inference
quote: AVX, AVX2, AVX512 and AMX support for x86 architectures

text: Supports integer quantization from 1.5-bit up to 8-bit to cut memory use and speed up inference
quote: 1.5-bit, 2-bit, 3-bit, 4-bit, 5-bit, 6-bit, and 8-bit integer quantization for faster inference and reduced memory use

text: Custom CUDA kernels for NVIDIA GPUs, plus AMD GPU support via HIP and Moore Threads GPUs via MUSA

text: Supports CPU+GPU hybrid inference to run models larger than available VRAM
quote: CPU+GPU hybrid inference to partially accelerate models larger than the total VRAM capacity

text: Can be run inside Docker containers per official docs

text: Prebuilt binaries are available for download from the GitHub releases page instead of compiling from source
